task: ai_terminal: pyte VT engine fully removed, libghostty-vt is now the sole engine (verified working, Dos Console tab, no cursor bug). Separately, found and fixed a real bug in the _LayoutWatcher resize-debounce logic (ai_terminal.py, class _LayoutWatcher, method _run) that silently stopped PTY resize from ever firing once the viewport size stabilized.

bug_fixed.what_was_wrong: _run() had an early-return `if size == self._last_measure: return` before the candidate-stability check. The candidate logic requires the SAME measured size on two consecutive polls before calling term.resize(). But the early-return set _last_measure to the new size on the FIRST poll that saw it, so the SECOND (confirming) poll -- which reads the identical size -- matched _last_measure and returned early, before ever reaching the candidate-count increment. Net effect: candidate_count could never reach 2 once the viewport stopped changing (the normal case), so resize silently never fired except during active size fluctuation.
bug_fixed.fix_applied: Removed the early-return guard entirely; the candidate-stability check now runs on every poll unconditionally, so two consecutive identical readings (whether or not they match a stale _last_measure) correctly confirm the candidate and fire term.resize().
bug_fixed.verified_live: Confirmed via eval_python live introspection on two open tabs (Dos Console, Pybackup Textual TUI): before the fix, watcher.candidate_count was permanently stuck at 1 across multiple poll cycles despite a stable, correct larger measured size (118x47) sitting unused while term._last_cols/_last_rows stayed at their stale spawn-time values (116x16 / 119x22). After mirroring the fix to Packages/User and reload_plugin, refreshing the two live terms' stale _watcher instances (reload_plugin does not rebind existing _watcher objects to the new class -- only _Terminal itself gets the upgrade-dance treatment in plugin_loaded) produced immediate correct behavior: console showed '[ai_terminal] resized PTY to 118x47' and '[ai_terminal] resized PTY to 121x38' firing as expected.
bug_fixed.caveat: The live-refresh of term._watcher was a manual testing patch only, done through eval_python on already-open tabs from before the reload. It was NOT written back into any persistent code path. This is not a problem going forward: any NEW terminal tab spawned after the reload gets a fresh _watcher instance built from the current (fixed) class automatically via normal _Terminal.__init__. Only tabs that were already open at the moment of that specific reload needed the manual patch, and Donal has since closed both of those tabs.
